text: This report seeks instruction to City Staff respecting the revised plans/revised application which the Applicant submitted on January 19, 2018 and February 16, 2018 for the purposes of the Ontario Municipal Board hearing of the Zoning By-Law Amendment appeals respecting 400 Front Street West, and to provide staff the opportunity to finalize the City's Issues List for the procedural order by March 29, 2018, as directed by the Board.

City Council on March 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council adopt the confidential recommendations in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 27, 2018) from the City Solicitor. 2. City Council authorize the public release of the confidential recommendations in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 27, 2018) from the City Solicitor. 3. City Council direct that the balance of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 27, 2018) from the City Solicitor remain confidential at the discretion of the City Solicitor, as it contains advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege. The confidential recommendations in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 27, 2018) from the City Solicitor were adopted by City Council and are now public, as follows: 1.
